page.layout: One column of index entries under the title INDEX. Roman numerals at the left, page numbers at the right. Some entries run over two or three lines.; One column of table-of-contents entries under the running head, with the page's catchword at the lower right and the gathering signature at the foot.

page.notes: The page number of XVII is partly covered by a blot and reads as "100" with uncertainty. Some page numbers are in old-style figures; they are given as Arabic numerals. The blue ruling is not transcribed. The large initial "D" is joined to "E divisione" as "DE divisione". The signature mark is read as "Q 5" with a doubtful final figure. Entry numbers are copied as printed.
